text:
ashwin: Starting canary rollout for runtime v2.3.1-quant-kernel -> canary-2 at 09:20. Includes new MatMul kernel rewrite and int8 quant path. Canaries set to 5%. Please watch p50/p95/p99, accuracy evals, and any regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime v2.3.1-quant-kernel -> canary-2 (5%) — job id dj-9832. Notifying metrics and smoke tests.

ben: FYI I've pinned prod routing for model-serving to 2.3.0 while canary runs so we can rollback quickly if needed.

ashwin: good call. quick pin config I used:
```
routes:
  runtime: 2.3.0
```

maria: smoke tests for chat and embeddings are green on the short-sequence suite. Found a tokenization edge-case on one test set, uploading diff now.

carol: Observability: p99 latency on canary nodes spiked to ~1.2s (was ~0.6s) for sequences >1024. p95 also nudged up. Could be kernel falling back to a slower path for large KV cache handling. :thinking_face:

ashwin: Ack. Pause expanding rollout. Do NOT increase % beyond 5%. Action: roll back long-sequence traffic to 2.3.0 and keep short-seq traffic on canary for further diagnostics. I'll add kernel-fallback logs.

ashwin: command to apply routing pin: `deploy-bot pin runtime 2.3.0 --scope prod-routing`

devops-bot: Routing change applied by devops-bot: prod runtime routed to 2.3.0 for seq>1024. Canary instances scaled down from 10 -> 3. Incident ticket created: IN-4521.

ashwin: Decision: hold this release. Draft release notes snippet: "MatMul kernel rewrite and int8 quantization path. Known issue: elevated p99 for sequences >1024 — disabled for long sequences until kernel fix." Tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up. Plan: fix kernel path, add microbench for seq>2048, run perf tests, then cut 2.3.2.

ben: I'll add a canary perf test for seq lengths 1024/2048/4096 to the perf-suite and gate the rollout.

maria: logs uploaded: s3://redwood-logs/runtime/1758001234-canary-quant.zip — contains kernel traces and tokenization diffs.

ashwin: thanks everyone. I'll open the PR with the fix plan and schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow in the change window (UTC 02:00-04:00).

carol: noted, will keep alerting on p99 and KV cache miss metrics.

ben: :thumbsup:
